title: Day 16/28 - Terraform + Azure Entra ID for Beginners | Identity Management Made Easy
description:
Welcome to the 16/28 day (Azure Entra ID for beginners) of Terraform Full Course for Beginners.

In this video, we will master Azure Entra ID automation using Terraform by transforming manual user management into a scalable Infrastructure as Code solution.

📚 Prerequisites:
- Azure Subscription
- Terraform installed
- Basic understanding of Azure Entra ID
- VS Code or any text editor
- Followed previous videos in the series for fundamental concepts of data source, variables, loops, etc

💡 Project Features:
- Bulk user creation from CSV
- Automated group management
- User-group association
- Service Principal authentication
- Scalable and reusable code

🚀 Follow Along:
All code shown in this tutorial is available on my GitHub: https://github.com/piyushsachdeva/Terraform-Full-Course-Azure/
